meta.name: prisma-driver-adapter-implementation
meta.description: Required reference for Prisma ORM 7 SQL driver adapter work. Use when implementing or modifying adapters, adding database drivers, or touching SqlDriverAdapter, Transaction, savepoint, result mapping, or DriverAdapterError behavior. Covers current transaction lifecycle, optional savepoint hooks, original database-error preservation, and verification.

howto.what: 当 Claude 被要求编写或修改 Prisma 用来连接数据库的组件时，它会遵守明确规则：每个事务独享一条连接，提交/回滚只做清理，保存点只能加在事务对象上，数据库错误要保留原始代码和消息。
howto.when: 当你要求实现或修改 Prisma 驱动适配器、添加数据库驱动，或处理事务等场景时触发。

howto.what_en: When asked to write or modify the Prisma component that talks to a database, Claude follows clear rules: each transaction has one dedicated connection, commit/rollback only clean up, savepoints live on the Transaction object, and database errors preserve original code/message.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to implement or modify a Prisma driver adapter, add a database driver, or handle transactions and similar scenarios.
